description: Create the basic project-local runtime directory structure needed for future autonomy work, such as `.bowman/runtime` and `.bowman/runtime/audit`, without removing or destabilizing current behavior.

status.comment:
Implemented the first runtime scaffold: backend project initialization now creates .bowman/runtime and .bowman/runtime/audit for future durable autonomy state.

Outcome: Extended ensureProjectStructure so newly initialized projects create .bowman/runtime and .bowman/runtime/audit alongside ideas, archived-ideas, and phases. Verified with backend build and full backend test suite. Effectiveness: This was a small but useful slice because it establishes a concrete place for future autonomy state without destabilizing current behavior. Lesson: Early autonomy work benefits from laying down project-local seams first. Small structural additions make later persistence features much cleaner. Pattern: Create the directory and ownership boundary before introducing new state files or runtime logic.
